surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating exposures of TiCl4 and H2O vapors, leading to surface reactions that fill voids between the AAO template and the substrate. The ALD technique enables conformal coating and precise thickness control, which firmly adheres the AAO template to the substrate.
